stem: The playwright uses figurative language in these sentences to show that Alyssa —

options.label: A
options.text: wants Samantha to realize that Samantha is abandoning the orchestra

options.label: B
options.text: believes that Samantha has chosen the newspaper over their friendship

options.label: C
options.text: worries that Samantha is writing for the newspaper because she doubts her musical talents

options.label: D
options.text: thinks Samantha will miss playing the violin while writing for the newspaper

visual_elements: ALYSSA: [Sighing.] Yes, I’m first violin in orchestra, but I’m not first violin to you. I’m still playing second fiddle, while you’re busy working on the newspaper.
